items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: His name was Bugs Hardaway, that was his name, but he was named after him.

ctx.x: Yup. His name was Bugs Hardaway, that was his name, but he was named after him. And so he did that at Loony Tunes, Merry Melody Cartoons at Warner Brothers.
How old were you when Bugs Bunny was invented?
